label: SUBSTANTIAL_UNITY_5: The disputed status of a material individual as one substance in its own right…
definition: The disputed status of a material individual as one substance in its own right, rather than merely a collection or operationally integrated plurality. In the independence test this is a primitive metaphysical predicate, not defined by composition, survival, organismic activity or the presence of a soul.
note: Open research vocabulary for #325/#329, not a proof that substantial unity exists. Source traditions, criteria and their adequacy require independent justification. Keeping this predicate independent prevents a circular argument from life to soul.

formal_gap.meaning: Scenario.SubstantialUnity p says that the material system at phase p is one substance in its own right, rather than merely a collection or an operationally integrated plurality. It is a predicate on the two phases (early, late) of the toy turnover history in TruthCore.Mereology.Vitalism (#329), supplied by each scenario, deliberately not defined by composition, survival, organismic activity or the presence of a soul.
formal_gap.examples_unavailable: Which material individuals have substantial unity is the disputed question (#325, #329); the toy scenarios give the predicate both values on the same observable history to show that the data do not decide it.
exclusions: A system or whole only as a description (DISAMB-MEREO-DESCRIPTION-BEARER).
Soul as form (SoulAsForm): kept independent so that an argument from life to soul is not circular.
open_obligations: Criteria of substantial unity and their adequacy need independent justification.

the formal statement SoulUnityIndependence, proved in result MEREO-005-SOUL-UNITY-INDEPENDENCE, says the observable profile fixes neither SubstantialUnity nor SoulAsForm; any bridge between them is an open premise.
No formalization candidate: kept primitive on purpose in the independence test.
